title: Architects of Japan’s Easy-Money Policies Are Changing Their Minds
description: As the Bank of Japan weighs another rate increase on Friday, a divide over how Japan should confront inflation is widening.

title: Emmy Winners 2026: See the Full List
description: Here are the winners from the 78th Emmy Awards.

title: An Heir to a Thai Beer Empire Accused His Brother of Sexual Abuse. Then He Took on His Family.
description: Siranudh Scott, an heir to Thailand’s Singha beer empire, has prompted a rare public reckoning about a topic considered taboo.

title: Prominent German Holocaust survivor, 93, receives death threat referencing right-wing AfD party’s election win
description: The exact content of the death threat was not clear, but it reportedly referenced the Holocaust survivor, the right-wing AfD and featured a Star of David.

title: Taylor Swift goes wild as Travis Kelce reaches milestone with electric play in Chiefs’ Week 1 win
description: Travis Kelce moved into second all time in receiving yards by a tight end on Monday night when he made a 59-yard catch in the third quarter and whipped Taylor Swift into a frenzy in his box at Arrowhead Stadium.

title: Jonah Tong delivers best start of Mets career even as fans boo him in favor of Pete Alonso
description: Last time, when Tong took the mound to face off with Jacob deGrom in his return to Citi Field, he did not make it out of the first inning in the worst outing of his career.

title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump Administration Plan to Screen Mail-In Ballots
description: The Trump administration had asked the justices to allow a new Postal Service plan to screen ballots just weeks before the midterm elections.

title: Devin Williams likely to be fast-tracked back to Mets bullpen after injury
description: In a lost season, Devin Williams is trying to establish health, if nothing else, and is nearing a return.

title: Ex-Dem insider exposes what Harris told top donors days before Biden dropped out: ‘All charade’
description: Lindy Li claims in her new book that Harris held donor calls insisting Biden would stay in the 2024 race while positioning herself as replacement.

title: Millions line up for ‘sacred henna’ at Indian temple
description: Drone visuals show masses lining up at Indian temple for sacred henna, believed to help unmarried people find a match.

title: Surrogate who refused abortion asks SCOTUS to intervene as baby could be moved out of Texas
description: Surrogate McKenna West asked the Supreme Court for an emergency administrative stay, fearing the newborn could be moved from Texas to California.
